## Validation / Validação

List checks actually run and results; mark physical checks pending when not run.
Liste verificações executadas e resultados; indique testes físicos pendentes.
See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/polarco/VitaTester/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) for checks proportional to this change.

- [ ] Documentation/translations and changelog updated where applicable.
- [ ] Test results distinguish host simulation, build and physical evidence.
- [ ] Original assets, credits and MIT license preserved.
- [ ] No dumps, credentials or personal information included.
